landed.uploaded_as: 5 hunk commits on claude/upkeep-traps (GitLab API); branch tree compared with the tested tree before merging

relationship_to_prior_patch: Incremental on GitLab main after merge request !37 (patch 0012). Do not reapply earlier patches.
reported: Follow-up questions on the Masinissa Marathon autorun save (410 BC): settler overproduction, and Rome without Writing at 410 BC

root_causes.rome: Mercenaries from turn 144: unit charges 45 of 96 commerce, financial trouble, slider 95% gold, research 3 beakers, settler allowance 0 with a site of value 3777 open
root_causes.civic_free_experience: AI_civicValue valued free experience as experience x population x 30% (war plan) x production multiplier: 45 per turn for Rome, more than the 31 gold the civic cost
root_causes.civic_unit_charges: projected unit charges not scaled by the handicap, AI and per-era percents and inflation (twice the real gold on Noble, 1.7x on Deity)
root_causes.civic_military_happiness: three military units assumed in every city
root_causes.disband: AI_disbandUnit(1) skipped every unit with more than 1 experience; Mercenaries gives 5 at birth, so nothing could be disbanded
root_causes.explorers: surplus explorers were scrapped only after AI_explore failed, which on a large map never happens (Rome: 14 scouts, need 3)
root_causes.settlers: 141 settlers created over the game, 122 cities founded, 18 alive at 410 BC: idle settlers, not overproduction; the causes were fixed by patch 0012

not_changed.civic_switch_horizon: AI_doCivics horizon is 2 x AI_CIVIC_CHANGE_DELAY at every speed while anarchy doubles on Marathon; scaling it raised anarchy from 33.5 to 45.5 player-turns per 40 turns (6 seeds) without measurable gain, so it was left for a longer study

validation.new_test_against_base: all four test cases fail (disband test by its assertion)

real_dll_harness.description: the 410 BC save continued 40 turns, six reseeded continuations per build, all seats AI
